honey.name: Honey
honey.desc: Sticky: for the next {value} layers a drop this close counts as perfect.

puff.name: Puff
puff.desc: Puffs up and widens this layer by {value}.

jelly.name: Jelly
jelly.desc: Shock absorber: calms the wobble by {value}, and for the next {layers} layers a normal drop springs back to the centre: the offset shrinks by {percent}%.

caramel.name: Caramel
caramel.desc: Sweet vein: coins are doubled for the next {value} layers.

frosty.name: Frosty
frosty.desc: Freeze: layers fly {value}% slower for the next 3 layers.

brownie.name: Brownie
brownie.desc: Sturdy: a shield saves you from the next miss. It lasts {value} layers.

sprinkle.name: Sprinkle
sprinkle.desc: Fireworks: score is multiplied by {value} for the next 5 layers.

crumb.name: Crumb
crumb.desc: Not a crumb wasted: for the next 6 layers every {value} px of a bitten-off edge becomes a coin.

ghost.name: Meringue
ghost.desc: See-through: guides show the perfect spot for the next {value} layers.

twins.name: Twins
twins.desc: Double portion: counts as 2 layers of height and gives {value} points.

lemon.name: Zesty
lemon.desc: Risk: for the next 4 layers the speed is +20%, score is multiplied by {value} and every perfect drop gives +1 coin.

rainbow.name: Rainbow
rainbow.desc: Miracle: the next {value} drops are perfect automatically, unless you miss completely.
